title: Trace Bloodlines with the Family Tree
use_cases: Use when visualizing complex multi-generational character lineages
Configure when switching between Royal, Parchment, Modern, Neon, or Forest aesthetic themes
Implement when distinguishing between varying relationship types like bastards, twins, or lovers
Use when needing to automatically organize family hierarchies from existing metadata
content:
Auto-built from typed relationships — spouse, sibling, parent, lover. The tree assembles itself across generations. Five themes, three layouts, one click to switch.

![Family Tree — multi-generation tree auto-built from typed character relationships with theme and layout options](https://proseengine.app/assets/landing-codex-family-tree.png?v=1)

👪

Auto-built Generations

Tag relationships once — the tree organises every generation for you

🎨

5 Themes, 3 Layouts

Royal, Parchment, Modern, Neon, Forest — vertical, horizontal, or radial

💕

Lovers, Bastards, Twins

Typed kinds capture the messy, human shape of every bloodline
